data.body: PS3: PS1/PS2 CI (Verified-1) surfaced a repo-wide contract I'd missed by running only the ticket's narrow verify commands. test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout::test_no_uncategorized_live_old_spelling scans ALL git-tracked files for legacy bridge spellings (bridge-fsck|bridge-probe|jira-onboard) and requires each retaining file to be in _COMPATIBILITY_FILES or immutable-history. My _registry.py necessarily names those live compat spellings (shadow-parity: the live _cli frozensets still route them), and test_cli_registry.py anchors on them - the same compatibility-surface category _cli/__init__.py and the other contract test files already occupy. Added src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py and tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py to _COMPATIBILITY_FILES. Verified locally: full bridge-vocabulary suite green + a 186-test sweep of source-scanning contracts/guards. The 6 other PS1 'failures' (doctor_dirty_tree, llm_failure_classifier) were artifacts of PS2's push canceling PS1's run mid-flight; they pass locally.
